item.title: The Cold War legend of Romania’s tank-melting laser
item.description: In 1968, a fantastic story spread that Nicolae Ceaușescu had stopped a Soviet invasion with a secret death ray. The weapon almost certainly never existed, but the myth served a powerful political purpose. This article is republished with permission from Laser Wars, a newsletter about military laser weapons and other futuristic defense technology.
